case_name: Dadu Ram Sonker vs State Of Chhattisgarh

parties.respondent_defendant: State Of Chhattisgarh, Collector, Raipur, Commissioner Municipal Coroporation Raipur, Superintendent Of Police Raipur, Arya Samj Temple

facts_of_case: Petitioner seeks relief against institutions cheating public at large; wants authorities to take action and control over marriage shops.

legal_principles.principle: Recognition of marriage is granted by the State Government under the Rules, 2006.
legal_principles.held: Thus, in the light of the above, it is submitted that the recognition of the marriage has been granted by the State Government under the Rules, 2006
applicable_acts_sections: Chhattisgarh Compulsory registration of Marriage Rules, 2006

legal_principles.principle: A valid marriage certificate issued under the relevant law by a competent authority is required for availing benefits.
legal_principles.held: Thus, in the light of the above, it is submitted that an Arya Samajee who has obtained a certificate under the Arya Samaj even they have to obtain the certificate under the Rules, 2006
applicable_acts_sections: Chhattisgarh Compulsory registration of Marriage Rules, 2006

outcome.final_order: Court directs respondents to examine provisions of Hindu Marriage Act, frame rules related to marriage act, and not recognize particular notary or pocket witness in solemnizing marriages.
